## 1. Label verification status

Label mode in this report: `all`. Human-verified labels: **0**. Assistant-read PROVISIONAL labels in use: **23**. Excluded by policy: 0. Pending-human-label intake receipts: 0.
Policy file: ai_review_of_company_receipts_permitted = `unknown - must be confirmed by an authorized company person`; assistant_read_labels = `provisional_included`.

**No authentic label in this corpus has been verified by a person.** Every authentic figure below depends on labels the assistant read from the page images; they are provisional. Synthetic and control labels are exact by construction and say nothing about real receipts.

## Retry-policy comparison (generated by scripts/compare_retry_policies.mjs)

Same 221 images, cold caches, same machine, run one after the other. v1 = unbounded retry (up to 6 extra attempts when the first pass is not 'usable'); v2 = bounded (skip when the first pass is already confident, attempts ordered by what the first pass looks like, stop on a usable or confident attempt, at most 4 attempts, 12 s budget).

| | v1 unbounded | v2 bounded |
|---|---|---|
| images retried | 76 ({"authentic":"5/22","synthetic":"48/174","generic_control":"22/24","suspected_template_generated":"1/1"}) | 38 ({"authentic":"5/22","synthetic":"29/174","generic_control":"4/24","suspected_template_generated":"0/1"}) |
| mean ms/image | 1250 | 705 |
| median ms | 294 | 252 |
| p95 ms | 3586 | 2611 |
| **worst ms** | **33532** | **11446** |
| total s over all images | 276 | 156 |
| retried images whose outcome improved / unchanged / worsened vs the single pass | 11 / 65 / 0 | 11 / 27 / 0 |

Safety check, image by image, v2 against v1: more false-confident fields: none; more false accepts: none; fewer true accepts: none; fewer exact fields: none. Images where v2 is better than v1: none.
v2 against the single pass (is the retry ever harmful?): never worse on any image.

**Verdict by the pre-set rule: ADOPT retry2.**
